environment.timeout_preflight_warning: options.timeout_s (3480s) looks implausible for a tran analysis with ~8.08e+05 timepoints (50p step, 40.4u window) -- even 50 timepoints/s (a generous floor, not a real engine-rate estimate) would need 1.62e+04s per corner. This is only a coarse, advisory pre-grid heuristic -- it does not block the sweep, and a plausible-looking budget can still turn out to be too short in practice.

timeout_budget_hint.message: The longest unit ran 2984.56s against options.timeout_s=3480s. This is a per-unit time budget, not a netlist problem: raise options.timeout_s (for example to 6960s) and re-run.
